findings.description: Every behavioral scenario uses the default tuning fixture, so hardcoded default constants can pass without honoring custom tuning.

findings.citation: Every snapshot record carries the ball's position, velocity and spin (angular velocity) and every player's position, velocity, facing, stamina and sprinting flag.
findings.description: The digestCoverage check mutates ball velocity/spin and player facing/stamina/sprinting, but never verifies that snapshots include ball position or player position/velocity.

findings.citation: `state_digest()` covers the ball's position, velocity and spin and every player's position, velocity, facing and stamina.
findings.description: The digestCoverage check never independently mutates ball position or player position/velocity, so those required digest components can be omitted while all clauses pass.

findings.citation: Every random draw in the simulation comes from the match's seeded `sim.rng`, so different seeds give different AI matches.
findings.description: The checks establish repeatability and seed-dependent outputs and detect the supplied Math.random stream, but do not verify that draws specifically use the match's sim.rng rather than another deterministic seeded generator.

findings.citation: Keep exported names, constructor signatures, public fields and method names unchanged: the checks build `new MatchSim(seed)`, set ball and player fields directly, call `tick()` with a `Map` of plan-contract inputs, `state_digest()`, `MatchLog.snapshot()`, `runMatchLog()` and `ScriptedProvider.per_tick`.
findings.description: The verifier exercises only the named integration surface and imports a small subset of exports; other pre-existing exported names and public methods can be removed or changed without a failing clause.
The kick clauses cover zero and an above-one value, but no negative value, so the required lower-bound clamping is not verified.

findings.citation: When the ball reaches an end line (`|x| >= length/2 - ball radius`) inside the goal mouth (`|z| < goal_width/2` and below `goal_height`), the attacking team scores, a `goal` event is emitted and the match restarts: the ball returns to the centre spot at rest, every player returns to their home position, and the conceding team kicks off (the scoring team's players get a `kickoff_reset_ticks` touch cooldown, the conceding team's none). Outside the goal mouth the ball rebounds off the wall.
findings.description: The goal tests check the exact post boundary but only bracket the crossbar (2.45 and 2.6); they do not verify that a ball exactly at goal_height is outside because the contract says strictly below.

findings.citation: R1 same-seed AI matches replay byte-identically
findings.description: This check also requires `kicked` to be true within 900 ticks, although R1 requires byte-identical replay and seed dependence, not that an AI match emit a kick within a fixed horizon.

findings.citation: R1 recorded per-tick inputs replay byte-identically
findings.description: This check additionally requires the replay to contain a kick, which is not part of the recorded-input replay determinism requirement.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
